messages:
maya: Quick weekly GPU capacity snapshot + asks before Thursday sync. TL;DR: small overall uptick, APAC shows a big short-term burst risk. Posting projected GPU-hours and immediate asks below.

maya: Region projections (next 7d):
- us-west: 22,000 GPU-hours (+8% w/w)
- us-east: 18,000 GPU-hours (+3% w/w)
- eu-west: 9,000 GPU-hours (+12% w/w) — note: cluster networking churn last weekend
- ap-south: 4,500 GPU-hours (+30% w/w) — seasonal spike + two enterprise rollouts

maya: Cluster-level notes:
- dedicated-pool-1 (rvm-ded-1): operating at 86% util on p4d-equivalent; can absorb ~1k GPU-hours with 3-4h spin-up.
- burst-pool-us (rvw-burst): currently capped by policy at 600 GPUs, we've hit cap 4x this week.
- private-vpc-ny: idle buffer ~200 GPUs but networking throttles on egress during backups.

maya: Risks & anomalies:
- ap-south preemption risk: cloud reports maintenance windows Tue-Wed, spot eviction ~12% historically -> recommend pre-warm reserved for critical customers.
- eu-west subnet exhaustion in eu-west-2 triggered node provisioning failures on Friday (netops ticket pending).
- observed 95th p99 latency jump on long sequences in us-west during peak batching; might be KV cache thrash.

maya: Cost/levers: shifting 1,200 GPU-hours to quantized 4-bit variants estimated to save ~18% in token cost but increases decode latency modestly. Autoscaler cooldown tuning could reduce burst pressure by smoothing ramp.

samir: Can we move ~800 GPU-hours from ap-south -> us-east to reduce preempt risk? If yes what's ETA to spin?

eli: We can reprovision in us-east, spin-up time ~3h if subnets/CIDR available. ap-south -> us-east live migrations for long jobs will require job-level checkpointing.

jia: Agree with pre-warm for ap-south. I'll flip autoscaler to prefer reserved nodes for enterprise tags and enable fallback to quantized model when latency > 300ms.

capacity-bot: Forecast delta alert: ap-south +30% vs baseline. Recommended action: pre-warm 200 GPUs in ap-south and add 3h buffer on autoscaler cooldown.

opsbot: Created INFRA-1423: "eu-west-2 CIDR expansion & node provisioning failures" assigned to @eli, priority P2.

samir: I'll commit to reserving 1,000 GPU-hours in us-west for the Dec holiday window (proposal in the reserve-plan doc). Will follow up with finance for budget ok.

maya: Action items summary (for Thurs sync 10:00 PT):
1) Pre-warm 200 GPUs in ap-south and set autoscaler buffer (jia)
2) Reserve 1,000 GPU-hours in us-west for holiday spike (samir)
3) CIDR/subnet expansion + eu-west mitigation (eli) — link INFRA-1423
4) Enable quantized fallback for high-latency routes and monitor quality/regression (jia + maya)
5) Ops: track preemption rates daily and report anomalies (capacity-bot)

maya: Any objections? If none I'll create consolidated runbook + Slack alert channel for this week's changes. :calendar: :loudspeaker:
